verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is a retail SaaS product, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions one. Sidekick is Shopify's own built-in assistant, llms.txt is a documentation aid, and POS UI extensions with GraphQL Admin API access are developer building blocks; none of these is an MCP server an external agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
